test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 31 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Allowing or assisting to discover
solution: The correct answer is '**Heuristic**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Heuristic**'. • It means '(used about ways of teaching) encouraging students to learn through doing and discovering things themselves rather than telling them about things'. [(शिक्षण के तरीक़े के लिए प्रयुक्त) स्वतः शोध एवं अनुभव पर आधारित] • *Example: When you visit the doctor, he will use **heuristic** methods to rule out certain medical conditions. * **Correct Answer:__** *Heuristic.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Conceptual**: relating to or based on mental concepts. (मानसिक अवधारणाओं पर आधारित या उससे संबंधित) • **Ineducative**: lack of education. (शिक्षा की कमी) • **Unempirical**: not based on observation or experience (अनुभवहीन) 4f:Td9c, The correct answer is '**reflects**'.
